units.rightText: And the cubit on the one side, and the cubit on the other side, of that which remaineth in the length of the curtains of the tent, shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.

units.leftText: You shall make a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.
units.rightText: And thou shalt make a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sealskins above.

units.leftText: “You shall make the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing upright.
units.rightText: And thou shalt make the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing up.

units.leftText: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and one and a half cubits the width of each board.
units.rightText: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and a cubit and a half the breadth of each board.

units.leftText: There shall be two tenons in each board, joined to one another: thus you shall make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
units.rightText: Two tenons shall there be in each board, joined one to another: thus shalt thou make for all the boards of the tabernacle.

units.leftText: You shall make twenty boards for the tabernacle, for the south side southward.
units.rightText: And thou shalt make the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards for the south side southward.

units.leftText: You shall make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.
units.rightText: And thou shalt make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons:

units.leftText: For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, twenty boards,
units.rightText: and for the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, twenty boards,

units.leftText: and their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
units.rightText: and their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

units.leftText: For the far side of the tabernacle westward you shall make six boards.
units.rightText: And for the hinder part of the tabernacle westward thou shalt make six boards.

units.leftText: You shall make two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far side.
units.rightText: And two boards shalt thou make for the corners of the tabernacle in the hinder part.

units.leftText: They shall be double beneath, and in the same way they shall be whole to its top to one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.
units.rightText: And they shall be double beneath, and in like manner they shall be entire unto the top thereof unto one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.

units.leftText: There shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
units.rightText: And there shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

units.leftText: “You shall make bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
units.rightText: And thou shalt make bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

units.leftText: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the far side westward.
units.rightText: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the hinder part westward.

units.leftText: The middle bar in the middle of the boards shall pass through from end to end.
units.rightText: And the middle bar in the midst of the boards shall pass through from end to end.

units.leftText: You shall overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars. You shall overlay the bars with gold.
units.rightText: And thou shalt overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars: and thou shalt overlay the bars with gold.

units.leftText: You shall set up the tabernacle according to the way that it was shown to you on the mountain.
units.rightText: And thou shalt rear up the tabernacle according to the fashion thereof which hath been showed thee in the mount.

units.leftText: “You shall make a veil of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. It shall be the work of a skillful workman.
units.rightText: And thou shalt make a veil of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: with cherubim the work of the skilful workman shall it be made:

units.leftText: You shall hang it on four pillars of acacia overlaid with gold; their hooks shall be of gold, on four sockets of silver.
units.rightText: and thou shalt hang it upon four pillars of acacia overlaid with gold; their hooks shall be of gold, upon four sockets of silver.

units.leftText: You shall hang up the veil under the clasps, and shall bring the ark of the covenant in there within the veil. The veil shall separate the holy place from the most holy for you.
units.rightText: And thou shalt hang up the veil under the clasps, and shalt bring in thither within the veil the ark of the testimony: and the veil shall separate unto you between the holy place and the most holy.

units.leftText: You shall put the mercy seat on the ark of the covenant in the most holy place.
units.rightText: And thou shalt put the mercy-seat upon the ark of the testimony in the most holy place.

units.leftText: You shall set the table outside the veil, and the lamp stand opposite the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south. You shall put the table on the north side.
units.rightText: And thou shalt set the table without the veil, and the candlestick over against the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south: and thou shalt put the table on the north side.

units.leftText: “You shall make a screen for the door of the Tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer.
units.rightText: And thou shalt make a screen for the door of the Tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer.

units.leftText: You shall make for the screen five pillars of acacia, and overlay them with gold. Their hooks shall be of gold. You shall cast five sockets of bronze for them.
units.rightText: And thou shalt make for the screen five pillars of acacia, and overlay them with gold: their hooks shall be of gold: and thou shalt cast five sockets of brass for them.

units.leftText: “You shall make the altar of acacia wood, five cubits long, and five cubits wide. The altar shall be square. Its height shall be three cubits.
units.rightText: And thou shalt make the altar of acacia wood, five cubits long, and five cubits broad; the altar shall be foursquare: and the height thereof shall be three cubits.
leftNotes: 27:1 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters.
27:1 The altar was to be about 2.3×2.3×1.4 meters or about 7½×7½×4½ feet.

units.leftText: You shall make its horns on its four corners. Its horns shall be of one piece with it. You shall overlay it with bronze.
units.rightText: And thou shalt make the horns of it upon the four corners thereof; the horns thereof shall be of one piece with it: and thou shalt overlay it with brass.

units.leftText: You shall make its pots to take away its ashes; and its shovels, its basins, its meat hooks, and its fire pans. You shall make all its vessels of bronze.
units.rightText: And thou shalt make its pots to take away its ashes, and its shovels, and its basins, and its flesh-hooks, and its firepans: all the vessels thereof thou shalt make of brass.

units.leftText: You shall make a grating for it of network of bronze. On the net you shall make four bronze rings in its four corners.
units.rightText: And thou shalt make for it a grating of network of brass: and upon the net shalt thou make four brazen rings in the four corners thereof.

units.leftText: You shall put it under the ledge around the altar beneath, that the net may reach halfway up the altar.
units.rightText: And thou shalt put it under the ledge round the altar beneath, that the net may reach halfway up the altar.

units.leftText: You shall make poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with bronze.
units.rightText: And thou shalt make staves for the altar, staves of acacia wood, and overlay them with brass.

units.leftText: Its poles shall be put into the rings, and the poles shall be on the two sides of the altar when carrying it.
units.rightText: And the staves thereof shall be put into the rings, and the staves shall be upon the two sides of the altar, in bearing it.

units.leftText: You shall make it hollow with planks. They shall make it as it has been shown you on the mountain.
units.rightText: Hollow with planks shalt thou make it: as it hath been showed thee in the mount, so shall they make it.

units.leftText: “You shall make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen one hundred cubits long for one side.
units.rightText: And thou shalt make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen a hundred cubits long for one side:

units.leftText: Its pillars shall be twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.
units.rightText: and the pillars thereof shall be twenty, and their sockets twenty, of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.

units.leftText: Likewise for the length of the north side, there shall be hangings one hundred cubits long, and its pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.
units.rightText: And likewise for the north side in length there shall be hangings a hundred cubits long, and the pillars thereof twenty, and their sockets twenty, of brass; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.

units.leftText: For the width of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits; their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.
units.rightText: And for the breadth of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits; their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.

units.leftText: The width of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.
units.rightText: And the breadth of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.

units.leftText: The hangings for the one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
units.rightText: The hangings for the one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

units.leftText: For the other side shall be hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
units.rightText: And for the other side shall be hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

units.leftText: For the gate of the court shall be a screen of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer; their pillars four, and their sockets four.
units.rightText: And for the gate of the court shall be a screen of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer; their pillars four, and their sockets four.

units.leftText: All the pillars of the court around shall be filleted with silver; their hooks of silver, and their sockets of bronze.
units.rightText: All the pillars of the court round about shall be filleted with silver; their hooks of silver, and their sockets of brass.

units.leftText: The length of the court shall be one hundred cubits, and the width fifty throughout, and the height five cubits, of fine twined linen, and their sockets of bronze.
units.rightText: The length of the court shall be a hundred cubits, and the breadth fifty every where, and the height five cubits, of fine twined linen, and their sockets of brass.

units.leftText: All the instruments of the tabernacle in all its service, and all its pins, and all the pins of the court, shall be of bronze.
units.rightText: All the instruments of the tabernacle in all the service thereof, and all the pins thereof, and all the pins of the court, shall be of brass.

units.leftText: “You shall command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.
units.rightText: And thou shalt command the children of Israel, that they bring unto thee pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.

units.leftText: In the Tent of Meeting, outside the veil which is before the covenant, Aaron and his sons shall keep it in order from evening to morning before the LORD: it shall be a statute forever throughout their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.
units.rightText: In the tent of meeting, without the veil which is before the testimony, Aaron and his sons shall keep it in order from evening to morning before Jehovah: it shall be a statute for ever throughout their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.

units.leftText: “Bring Aaron your brother, and his sons with him, near to you from among the children of Israel, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office: Aaron, with Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar, Aaron’s sons.
units.rightText: And bring thou near unto thee Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him, from among the children of Israel, that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office, even Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron’s sons.

units.leftText: You shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother, for glory and for beauty.
units.rightText: And thou shalt make holy garments for Aaron thy brother, for glory and for beauty.

units.leftText: You shall speak to all who are wise-hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they make Aaron’s garments to sanctify him, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.
units.rightText: And thou shalt speak unto all that are wise-hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they make Aaron’s garments to sanctify him, that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office.

units.leftText: These are the garments which they shall make: a breastplate, an ephod, a robe, a fitted tunic, a turban, and a sash. They shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother and his sons, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.
units.rightText: And these are the garments which they shall make: a breastplate, and an ephod, and a robe, and a coat of checker work, a mitre, and a girdle: and they shall make holy garments for Aaron thy brother, and his sons, that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office.

units.leftText: They shall use the gold, and the blue, and the purple, and the scarlet, and the fine linen.
units.rightText: And they shall take the gold, and the blue, and the purple, and the scarlet, and the fine linen.

units.leftText: “They shall make the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the skillful workman.
units.rightText: And they shall make the ephod of gold, of blue, and purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the skilful workman.

units.leftText: It shall have two shoulder straps joined to the two ends of it, that it may be joined together.
units.rightText: It shall have two shoulder-pieces joined to the two ends thereof, that it may be joined together.

units.leftText: The skillfully woven band, which is on it, shall be like its work and of the same piece; of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.
units.rightText: And the skilfully woven band, which is upon it, wherewith to gird it on, shall be like the work thereof and of the same piece; of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.

units.leftText: You shall take two onyx stones, and engrave on them the names of the children of Israel.
units.rightText: And thou shalt take two onyx stones, and grave on them the names of the children of Israel:

units.leftText: Six of their names on the one stone, and the names of the six that remain on the other stone, in the order of their birth.
units.rightText: six of their names on the one stone, and the names of the six that remain on the other stone, according to their birth.

units.leftText: With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, you shall engrave the two stones, according to the names of the children of Israel. You shall make them to be enclosed in settings of gold.
units.rightText: With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, shalt thou engrave the two stones, according to the names of the children of Israel: thou shalt make them to be inclosed in settings of gold.

units.leftText: You shall put the two stones on the shoulder straps of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel. Aaron shall bear their names before the LORD on his two shoulders for a memorial.
units.rightText: And thou shalt put the two stones upon the shoulder-pieces of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel: and Aaron shall bear their names before Jehovah upon his two shoulders for a memorial.

units.leftText: You shall make settings of gold,
units.rightText: And thou shalt make settings of gold,

units.leftText: and two chains of pure gold; you shall make them like cords of braided work. You shall put the braided chains on the settings.
units.rightText: and two chains of pure gold; like cords shalt thou make them, of wreathen work: and thou shalt put the wreathen chains on the settings.

units.leftText: “You shall make a breastplate of judgment, the work of the skillful workman; like the work of the ephod you shall make it; of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, you shall make it.
units.rightText: And thou shalt make a breastplate of judgment, the work of the skilful workman; like the work of the ephod thou shalt make it; of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, shalt thou make it.

units.leftText: It shall be square and folded double; a span shall be its length, and a span its width.
units.rightText: Foursquare it shall be and double; a span shall be the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof.
leftNotes: 28:16 A span is the length from the tip of a man’s thumb to the tip of his little finger when his hand is stretched out (about half a cubit, or 9 inches, or 22.8 cm.)

units.leftText: You shall set in it settings of stones, four rows of stones: a row of ruby, topaz, and beryl shall be the first row;
units.rightText: And thou shalt set in it settings of stones, four rows of stones: a row of sardius, topaz, and carbuncle shall be the first row;

units.leftText: and the second row a turquoise, a sapphire, and an emerald;
units.rightText: and the second row an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond;
leftNotes: 28:18 or, lapis lazuli

units.leftText: and the third row a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
units.rightText: and the third row a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

units.leftText: and the fourth row a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They shall be enclosed in gold in their settings.
units.rightText: and the fourth row a beryl, and an onyx, and a jasper: they shall be inclosed in gold in their settings.

units.leftText: The stones shall be according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, everyone according to his name, they shall be for the twelve tribes.
units.rightText: And the stones shall be according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, every one according to his name, they shall be for the twelve tribes.

units.leftText: You shall make on the breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold.
units.rightText: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate chains like cords, of wreathen work of pure gold.

units.leftText: You shall make on the breastplate two rings of gold, and shall put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.
units.rightText: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate two rings of gold, and shalt put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.

units.leftText: You shall put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.
units.rightText: And thou shalt put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.

units.leftText: The other two ends of the two braided chains you shall put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod in its forepart.
units.rightText: And the other two ends of the two wreathen chains thou shalt put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder-pieces of the ephod in the forepart thereof.

units.leftText: You shall make two rings of gold, and you shall put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its edge, which is toward the side of the ephod inward.
units.rightText: And thou shalt make two rings of gold, and thou shalt put them upon the two ends of the breastplate, upon the edge thereof, which is toward the side of the ephod inward.

units.leftText: You shall make two rings of gold, and shall put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath, in its forepart, close by its coupling, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.
units.rightText: And thou shalt make two rings of gold, and shalt put them on the two shoulder-pieces of the ephod underneath, in the forepart thereof, close by the coupling thereof, above the skilfully woven band of the ephod.

units.leftText: They shall bind the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate may not swing out from the ephod.
units.rightText: And they shall bind the breastplate by the rings thereof unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be upon the skilfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate be not loosed from the ephod.

units.leftText: Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment on his heart, when he goes in to the holy place, for a memorial before the LORD continually.
units.rightText: And Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment upon his heart, when he goeth in unto the holy place, for a memorial before Jehovah continually.

units.leftText: You shall put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be on Aaron’s heart, when he goes in before the LORD. Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel on his heart before the LORD continually.
units.rightText: And thou shalt put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be upon Aaron’s heart, when he goeth in before Jehovah: and Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel upon his heart before Jehovah continually.

units.leftText: “You shall make the robe of the ephod all of blue.
units.rightText: And thou shalt make the robe of the ephod all of blue.

units.leftText: It shall have a hole for the head in the middle of it. It shall have a binding of woven work around its hole, as it were the hole of a coat of mail, that it not be torn.
units.rightText: And it shall have a hole for the head in the midst thereof: it shall have a binding of woven work round about the hole of it, as it were the hole of a coat of mail, that it be not rent.

units.leftText: On its hem you shall make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, all around its hem; with bells of gold between and around them:
units.rightText: And upon the skirts of it thou shalt make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, round about the skirts thereof; and bells of gold between them round about:

units.leftText: a golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, around the hem of the robe.
units.rightText: a golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, upon the skirts of the robe round about.

units.leftText: It shall be on Aaron to minister: and its sound shall be heard when he goes in to the holy place before the LORD, and when he comes out, that he not die.
units.rightText: And it shall be upon Aaron to minister: and the sound thereof shall be heard when he goeth in unto the holy place before Jehovah, and when he cometh out, that he die not.

units.leftText: “You shall make a plate of pure gold, and engrave on it, like the engravings of a signet, ‘HOLY TO THE LORD.’
units.rightText: And thou shalt make a plate of pure gold, and grave upon it, like the engravings of a signet, HOLY TO JEHOVAH.

units.leftText: You shall put it on a lace of blue, and it shall be on the sash. It shall be on the front of the sash.
units.rightText: And thou shalt put it on a lace of blue, and it shall be upon the mitre; upon the forefront of the mitre it shall be.

units.leftText: It shall be on Aaron’s forehead, and Aaron shall bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall make holy in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always on his forehead, that they may be accepted before the LORD.
units.rightText: And it shall be upon Aaron’s forehead, and Aaron shall bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall hallow in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always upon his forehead, that they may be accepted before Jehovah.

units.leftText: You shall weave the tunic with fine linen. You shall make a turban of fine linen. You shall make a sash, the work of the embroiderer.
units.rightText: And thou shalt weave the coat in checker work of fine linen, and thou shalt make a mitre of fine linen, and thou shalt make a girdle, the work of the embroiderer.

units.leftText: “You shall make tunics for Aaron’s sons. You shall make sashes for them. You shall make headbands for them, for glory and for beauty.
units.rightText: And for Aaron’s sons thou shalt make coats, and thou shalt make for them girdles, and head-tires shalt thou make for them, for glory and for beauty.

units.leftText: You shall put them on Aaron your brother, and on his sons with him, and shall anoint them, and consecrate them, and sanctify them, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office.
units.rightText: And thou shalt put them upon Aaron thy brother, and upon his sons with him, and shalt anoint them, and consecrate them, and sanctify them, that they may minister unto me in the priest’s office.

units.leftText: You shall make them linen pants to cover their naked flesh. They shall reach from the waist even to the thighs.
units.rightText: And thou shalt make them linen breeches to cover the flesh of their nakedness; from the loins even unto the thighs they shall reach:

units.leftText: They shall be on Aaron and on his sons, when they go in to the Tent of Meeting, or when they come near to the altar to minister in the holy place, that they don’t bear iniquity, and die. This shall be a statute forever to him and to his offspring after him.
units.rightText: and they shall be upon Aaron, and upon his sons, when they go in unto the tent of meeting, or when they come near unto the altar to minister in the holy place; that they bear not iniquity, and die: it shall be a statute for ever unto him and unto his seed after him.

units.leftText: “This is the thing that you shall do to them to make them holy, to minister to me in the priest’s office: take one young bull and two rams without defect,
units.rightText: And this is the thing that thou shalt do unto them to hallow them, to minister unto me in the priest’s office: take one young bullock and two rams without blemish,

units.leftText: unleavened bread, unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil. You shall make them of fine wheat flour.
units.rightText: and unleavened bread, and cakes unleavened mingled with oil, and wafers unleavened anointed with oil: of fine wheaten flour shalt thou make them.

units.leftText: You shall put them into one basket, and bring them in the basket, with the bull and the two rams.
units.rightText: And thou shalt put them into one basket, and bring them in the basket, with the bullock and the two rams.

units.leftText: You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and shall wash them with water.
units.rightText: And Aaron and his sons thou shalt bring unto the door of the tent of meeting, and shalt wash them with water.

units.leftText: You shall take the garments, and put on Aaron the tunic, the robe of the ephod, the ephod, and the breastplate, and clothe him with the skillfully woven band of the ephod.
units.rightText: And thou shalt take the garments, and put upon Aaron the coat, and the robe of the ephod, and the ephod, and the breastplate, and gird him with the skilfully woven band of the ephod;

units.leftText: You shall set the turban on his head, and put the holy crown on the turban.
units.rightText: and thou shalt set the mitre upon his head, and put the holy crown upon the mitre.

units.leftText: Then you shall take the anointing oil, and pour it on his head, and anoint him.
units.rightText: Then shalt thou take the anointing oil, and pour it upon his head, and anoint him.

units.leftText: You shall bring his sons, and put tunics on them.
units.rightText: And thou shalt bring his sons, and put coats upon them.

units.leftText: You shall clothe them with belts, Aaron and his sons, and bind headbands on them. They shall have the priesthood by a perpetual statute. You shall consecrate Aaron and his sons.
units.rightText: And thou shalt gird them with girdles, Aaron and his sons, and bind head-tires on them: and they shall have the priesthood by a perpetual statute: and thou shalt consecrate Aaron and his sons.

units.leftText: “You shall bring the bull before the Tent of Meeting; and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the bull.
units.rightText: And thou shalt bring the bullock before the tent of meeting: and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands upon the head of the bullock.

units.leftText: You shall kill the bull before the LORD at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
units.rightText: And thou shalt kill the bullock before Jehovah, at the door of the tent of meeting.

units.leftText: You shall take of the blood of the bull, and put it on the horns of the altar with your finger; and you shall pour out all the blood at the base of the altar.
units.rightText: And thou shalt take of the blood of the bullock, and put it upon the horns of the altar with thy finger; and thou shalt pour out all the blood at the base of the altar.

units.leftText: You shall take all the fat that covers the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, and burn them on the altar.
units.rightText: And thou shalt take all the fat that covereth the inwards, and the caul upon the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and burn them upon the altar.

units.leftText: But the meat of the bull, and its skin, and its dung, you shall burn with fire outside of the camp. It is a sin offering.
units.rightText: But the flesh of the bullock, and its skin, and its dung, shalt thou burn with fire without the camp: it is a sin-offering.

units.leftText: “You shall also take the one ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram.
units.rightText: Thou shalt also take the one ram; and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands upon the head of the ram.

units.leftText: You shall kill the ram, and you shall take its blood, and sprinkle it around on the altar.
units.rightText: And thou shalt slay the ram, and thou shalt take its blood, and sprinkle it round about upon the altar.

units.leftText: You shall cut the ram into its pieces, and wash its innards, and its legs, and put them with its pieces, and with its head.
units.rightText: And thou shalt cut the ram into its pieces, and wash its inwards, and its legs, and put them with its pieces, and with its head.

units.leftText: You shall burn the whole ram on the altar: it is a burnt offering to the LORD; it is a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
units.rightText: And thou shalt burn the whole ram upon the altar: it is a burnt-offering unto Jehovah; it is a sweet savor, an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.

units.leftText: “You shall take the other ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram.
units.rightText: And thou shalt take the other ram; and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands upon the head of the ram.

units.leftText: Then you shall kill the ram, and take some of its blood, and put it on the tip of the right ear of Aaron, and on the tip of the right ear of his sons, and on the thumb of their right hand, and on the big toe of their right foot; and sprinkle the blood around on the altar.
units.rightText: Then shalt thou kill the ram, and take of its blood, and put it upon the tip of the right ear of Aaron, and upon the tip of the right ear of his sons, and upon the thumb of their right hand, and upon the great toe of their right foot, and sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.

units.leftText: You shall take of the blood that is on the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it on Aaron, and on his garments, and on his sons, and on the garments of his sons with him: and he shall be made holy, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.
units.rightText: And thou shalt take of the blood that is upon the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon the garments of his sons with him: and he shall be hallowed, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.

units.leftText: Also you shall take some of the ram’s fat, the fat tail, the fat that covers the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys, the fat that is on them, and the right thigh (for it is a ram of consecration),
units.rightText: Also thou shalt take of the ram the fat, and the fat tail, and the fat that covereth the inwards, and the caul of the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and the right thigh (for it is a ram of consecration),

units.leftText: and one loaf of bread, one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of unleavened bread that is before the LORD.
units.rightText: and one loaf of bread, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, out of the basket of unleavened bread that is before Jehovah:

units.leftText: You shall put all of this in Aaron’s hands, and in his sons’ hands, and shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD.
units.rightText: and thou shalt put the whole upon the hands of Aaron, and upon the hands of his sons, and shalt wave them for a wave-offering before Jehovah.

units.leftText: You shall take them from their hands, and burn them on the altar on the burnt offering, for a pleasant aroma before the LORD: it is an offering made by fire to the LORD.
units.rightText: And thou shalt take them from their hands, and burn them on the altar upon the burnt-offering, for a sweet savor before Jehovah: it is an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.

units.leftText: “You shall take the breast of Aaron’s ram of consecration, and wave it for a wave offering before the LORD. It shall be your portion.
units.rightText: And thou shalt take the breast of Aaron’s ram of consecration, and wave it for a wave-offering before Jehovah: and it shall be thy portion.

units.leftText: You shall sanctify the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the wave offering, which is waved, and which is raised up, of the ram of consecration, even of that which is for Aaron, and of that which is for his sons.
units.rightText: And thou shalt sanctify the breast of the wave-offering, and the thigh of the heave-offering, which is waved, and which is heaved up, of the ram of consecration, even of that which is for Aaron, and of that which is for his sons:

units.leftText: It shall be for Aaron and his sons as their portion forever from the children of Israel; for it is a wave offering. It shall be a wave offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifices of their peace offerings, even their wave offering to the LORD.
units.rightText: and it shall be for Aaron and his sons as their portion for ever from the children of Israel; for it is a heave-offering: and it shall be a heave-offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifices of their peace-offerings, even their heave-offering unto Jehovah.

units.leftText: “The holy garments of Aaron shall be for his sons after him, to be anointed in them, and to be consecrated in them.
units.rightText: And the holy garments of Aaron shall be for his sons after him, to be anointed in them, and to be consecrated in them.

units.leftText: Seven days shall the son who is priest in his place put them on, when he comes into the Tent of Meeting to minister in the holy place.
units.rightText: Seven days shall the son that is priest in his stead put them on, when he cometh into the tent of meeting to minister in the holy place.

units.leftText: “You shall take the ram of consecration and boil its meat in a holy place.
units.rightText: And thou shalt take the ram of consecration, and boil its flesh in a holy place.

units.leftText: Aaron and his sons shall eat the meat of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket, at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
units.rightText: And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket, at the door of the tent of meeting.

units.leftText: They shall eat those things with which atonement was made, to consecrate and sanctify them; but a stranger shall not eat of it, because they are holy.
units.rightText: And they shall eat those things wherewith atonement was made, to consecrate and to sanctify them: but a stranger shall not eat thereof, because they are holy.

units.leftText: If anything of the meat of the consecration, or of the bread, remains to the morning, then you shall burn the remainder with fire. It shall not be eaten, because it is holy.
units.rightText: And if aught of the flesh of the consecration, or of the bread, remain unto the morning, then thou shalt burn the remainder with fire: it shall not be eaten, because it is holy.

units.leftText: “You shall do so to Aaron and to his sons, according to all that I have commanded you. You shall consecrate them seven days.
units.rightText: And thus shalt thou do unto Aaron, and to his sons, according to all that I have commanded thee: seven days shalt thou consecrate them.

units.leftText: Every day you shall offer the bull of sin offering for atonement. You shall cleanse the altar when you make atonement for it. You shall anoint it, to sanctify it.
units.rightText: And every day shalt thou offer the bullock of sin-offering for atonement: and thou shalt cleanse the altar, when thou makest atonement for it; and thou shalt anoint it, to sanctify it.

units.leftText: Seven days you shall make atonement for the altar, and sanctify it; and the altar shall be most holy. Whatever touches the altar shall be holy.
units.rightText: Seven days thou shalt make atonement for the altar, and sanctify it: and the altar shall be most holy; whatsoever toucheth the altar shall be holy.

units.leftText: “Now this is that which you shall offer on the altar: two lambs a year old day by day continually.
units.rightText: Now this is that which thou shalt offer upon the altar: two lambs a year old day by day continually.

units.leftText: The one lamb you shall offer in the morning; and the other lamb you shall offer at evening;
units.rightText: The one lamb thou shalt offer in the morning; and the other lamb thou shalt offer at even:

units.leftText: and with the one lamb a tenth part of an ephah of fine flour mixed with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil, and the fourth part of a hin of wine for a drink offering.
units.rightText: and with the one lamb a tenth part of an ephah of fine flour mingled with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil, and the fourth part of a hin of wine for a drink-offering.
leftNotes: 29:40 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel
29:40 A hin is about 6.5 liters or 1.7 gallons, so a fourth of a hin is about 1.6 liters.

units.leftText: The other lamb you shall offer at evening, and shall do to it according to the meal offering of the morning and according to its drink offering, for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
units.rightText: And the other lamb thou shalt offer at even, and shalt do thereto according to the meal-offering of the morning, and according to the drink-offering thereof, for a sweet savor, an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.

units.leftText: It shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the Tent of Meeting before the LORD, where I will meet with you, to speak there to you.
units.rightText: It shall be a continual burnt-offering throughout your generations at the door of the tent of meeting before Jehovah, where I will meet with you, to speak there unto thee.

units.leftText: There I will meet with the children of Israel; and the place shall be sanctified by my glory.
units.rightText: And there I will meet with the children of Israel; and the Tent shall be sanctified by my glory.

units.leftText: I will sanctify the Tent of Meeting and the altar. I will also sanctify Aaron and his sons to minister to me in the priest’s office.
units.rightText: And I will sanctify the tent of meeting, and the altar: Aaron also and his sons will I sanctify, to minister to me in the priest’s office.

units.leftText: I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will be their God.
units.rightText: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will be their God.

units.leftText: They shall know that I am the LORD their God, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, that I might dwell among them: I am the LORD their God.
units.rightText: And they shall know that I am Jehovah their God, that brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, that I might dwell among them: I am Jehovah their God.

units.leftText: “You shall make an altar to burn incense on. You shall make it of acacia wood.
units.rightText: And thou shalt make an altar to burn incense upon: of acacia wood shalt thou make it.

units.leftText: Its length shall be a cubit, and its width a cubit. It shall be square, and its height shall be two cubits. Its horns shall be of one piece with it.
units.rightText: A cubit shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof; foursquare shall it be; and two cubits shall be the height thereof: the horns thereof shall be of one piece with it.
leftNotes: 30:2 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters.

units.leftText: You shall overlay it with pure gold, its top, its sides around it, and its horns; and you shall make a gold molding around it.
units.rightText: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, the top thereof, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns thereof; and thou shalt make unto it a crown of gold round about.

units.leftText: You shall make two golden rings for it under its molding; on its two ribs, on its two sides you shall make them; and they shall be for places for poles with which to bear it.
units.rightText: And two golden rings shalt thou make for it under the crown thereof; upon the two ribs thereof, upon the two sides of it shalt thou make them; and they shall be for places for staves wherewith to bear it.

units.leftText: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.
units.rightText: And thou shalt make the staves of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.

units.leftText: You shall put it before the veil that is by the ark of the covenant, before the mercy seat that is over the covenant, where I will meet with you.
units.rightText: And thou shalt put it before the veil that is by the ark of the testimony, before the mercy-seat that is over the testimony, where I will meet with thee.

units.leftText: Aaron shall burn incense of sweet spices on it every morning. When he tends the lamps, he shall burn it.
units.rightText: And Aaron shall burn thereon incense of sweet spices: every morning, when he dresseth the lamps, he shall burn it.

units.leftText: When Aaron lights the lamps at evening, he shall burn it, a perpetual incense before the LORD throughout your generations.
units.rightText: And when Aaron lighteth the lamps at even, he shall burn it, a perpetual incense before Jehovah throughout your generations.

units.leftText: You shall offer no strange incense on it, nor burnt offering, nor meal offering; and you shall pour no drink offering on it.
units.rightText: Ye shall offer no strange incense thereon, nor burnt-offering, nor meal-offering; and ye shall pour no drink-offering thereon.

units.leftText: Aaron shall make atonement on its horns once in the year; with the blood of the sin offering of atonement once in the year he shall make atonement for it throughout your generations. It is most holy to the LORD.”
units.rightText: And Aaron shall make atonement upon the horns of it once in the year; with the blood of the sin-offering of atonement once in the year shall he make atonement for it throughout your generations: it is most holy unto Jehovah.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “When you take a census of the children of Israel, according to those who are counted among them, then each man shall give a ransom for his soul to the LORD when you count them, that there be no plague among them when you count them.
units.rightText: When thou takest the sum of the children of Israel, according to those that are numbered of them, then shall they give every man a ransom for his soul unto Jehovah, when thou numberest them; that there be no plague among them, when thou numberest them.

units.leftText: They shall give this, everyone who passes over to those who are counted, half a shekel according to the shekel of the sanctuary (the shekel is twenty gerahs ); half a shekel for an offering to the LORD.
units.rightText: This they shall give, every one that passeth over unto them that are numbered, half a shekel after the shekel of the sanctuary; (the shekel is twenty gerahs), half a shekel for an offering to Jehovah.
leftNotes: 30:13 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces.
30:13 a gerah is about 0.5 grams or about 7.7 grains

units.leftText: Everyone who passes over to those who are counted, from twenty years old and upward, shall give the offering to the LORD.
units.rightText: Every one that passeth over unto them that are numbered, from twenty years old and upward, shall give the offering of Jehovah.

units.leftText: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less, than the half shekel, when they give the offering of the LORD, to make atonement for your souls.
units.rightText: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less, than the half shekel, when they give the offering of Jehovah, to make atonement for your souls.
leftNotes: 30:15 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces.

units.leftText: You shall take the atonement money from the children of Israel, and shall appoint it for the service of the Tent of Meeting; that it may be a memorial for the children of Israel before the LORD, to make atonement for your souls.”
units.rightText: And thou shalt take the atonement money from the children of Israel, and shalt appoint it for the service of the tent of meeting; that it may be a memorial for the children of Israel before Jehovah, to make atonement for your souls.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “You shall also make a basin of bronze, and its base of bronze, in which to wash. You shall put it between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and you shall put water in it.
units.rightText: Thou shalt also make a laver of brass, and the base thereof of brass, whereat to wash. And thou shalt put it between the tent of meeting and the altar, and thou shalt put water therein.

units.leftText: Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet in it.
units.rightText: And Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet thereat:

units.leftText: When they go into the Tent of Meeting, they shall wash with water, that they don’t die; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn an offering made by fire to the LORD.
units.rightText: when they go into the tent of meeting, they shall wash with water, that they die not; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.

units.leftText: So they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they not die. This shall be a statute forever to them, even to him and to his descendants throughout their generations.”
units.rightText: So they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they die not: and it shall be a statute for ever to them, even to him and to his seed throughout their generations.

units.leftText: Moreover the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: Moreover Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Also take fine spices: of liquid myrrh, five hundred shekels; and of fragrant cinnamon half as much, even two hundred and fifty; and of fragrant cane, two hundred and fifty;
units.rightText: Take thou also unto thee the chief spices: of flowing myrrh five hundred shekels, and of sweet cinnamon half so much, even two hundred and fifty, and of sweet calamus two hundred and fifty,
leftNotes: 30:23 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces, so 500 shekels is about 5 kilograms or about 11 pounds.

units.leftText: and of cassia five hundred, according to the shekel of the sanctuary; and a hin of olive oil.
units.rightText: and of cassia five hundred, after the shekel of the sanctuary, and of olive oil a hin;
leftNotes: 30:24 A hin is about 6.5 liters or 1.7 gallons.

units.leftText: You shall make it into a holy anointing oil, a perfume compounded after the art of the perfumer: it shall be a holy anointing oil.
units.rightText: and thou shalt make it a holy anointing oil, a perfume compounded after the art of the perfumer: it shall be a holy anointing oil.

units.leftText: You shall use it to anoint the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the covenant,
units.rightText: And thou shalt anoint therewith the tent of meeting, and the ark of the testimony,

units.leftText: the table and all its articles, the lamp stand and its accessories, the altar of incense,
units.rightText: and the table and all the vessels thereof, and the candlestick and the vessels thereof, and the altar of incense,

units.leftText: the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the basin with its base.
units.rightText: and the altar of burnt-offering with all the vessels thereof, and the laver and the base thereof.

units.leftText: You shall sanctify them, that they may be most holy. Whatever touches them shall be holy.
units.rightText: And thou shalt sanctify them, that they may be most holy: whatsoever toucheth them shall be holy.

units.leftText: You shall anoint Aaron and his sons, and sanctify them, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office.
units.rightText: And thou shalt anoint Aaron and his sons, and sanctify them, that they may minister unto me in the priest’s office.

units.leftText: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘This shall be a holy anointing oil to me throughout your generations.
units.rightText: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, This shall be a holy anointing oil unto me throughout your generations.

units.leftText: It shall not be poured on man’s flesh, and do not make any like it, according to its composition. It is holy. It shall be holy to you.
units.rightText: Upon the flesh of man shall it not be poured, neither shall ye make any like it, according to the composition thereof: it is holy, and it shall be holy unto you.

units.leftText: Whoever compounds any like it, or whoever puts any of it on a stranger, he shall be cut off from his people.’”
units.rightText: Whosoever compoundeth any like it, or whosoever putteth any of it upon a stranger, he shall be cut off from his people.

units.leftText: The LORD said to Moses, “Take to yourself sweet spices, gum resin, onycha, and galbanum: sweet spices with pure frankincense. There shall be an equal weight of each.
units.rightText: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Take unto thee sweet spices, stacte, and onycha, and galbanum; sweet spices with pure frankincense: of each shall there be a like weight;

units.leftText: You shall make incense of it, a perfume after the art of the perfumer, seasoned with salt, pure and holy.
units.rightText: and thou shalt make of it incense, a perfume after the art of the perfumer, seasoned with salt, pure and holy:

units.leftText: You shall beat some of it very small, and put some of it before the covenant in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet with you. It shall be to you most holy.
units.rightText: and thou shalt beat some of it very small, and put of it before the testimony in the tent of meeting, where I will meet with thee: it shall be unto you most holy.

units.leftText: You shall not make this incense, according to its composition, for yourselves: it shall be to you holy for the LORD.
units.rightText: And the incense which thou shalt make, according to the composition thereof ye shall not make for yourselves: it shall be unto thee holy for Jehovah.

units.leftText: Whoever shall make any like that, to smell of it, he shall be cut off from his people.”
units.rightText: Whosoever shall make like unto that, to smell thereof, he shall be cut off from his people.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Behold, I have called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
units.rightText: See, I have called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah:

units.leftText: I have filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all kinds of workmanship,
units.rightText: and I have filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship,

units.leftText: to devise skillful works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in bronze,
units.rightText: to devise skilful works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,

units.leftText: and in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all kinds of workmanship.
units.rightText: and in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all manner of workmanship.

units.leftText: Behold, I myself have appointed with him Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan; and in the heart of all who are wise-hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded you:
units.rightText: And I, behold, I have appointed with him Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan; and in the heart of all that are wise-hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded thee:

units.leftText: the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the covenant, the mercy seat that is on it, all the furniture of the Tent,

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Speak also to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Most certainly you shall keep my Sabbaths; for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations, that you may know that I am the LORD who sanctifies you.
units.rightText: Speak thou also unto the children of Israel, saying, Verily ye shall keep my sabbaths: for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations; that ye may know that I am Jehovah who sanctifieth you.

units.leftText: You shall keep the Sabbath therefore, for it is holy to you. Everyone who profanes it shall surely be put to death; for whoever does any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
units.rightText: Ye shall keep the sabbath therefore; for it is holy unto you: every one that profaneth it shall surely be put to death; for whosoever doeth any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

units.leftText: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, holy to the LORD. Whoever does any work on the Sabbath day shall surely be put to death.

units.rightText: It is a sign between me and the children of Israel for ever: for in six days Jehovah made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.

units.leftText: When he finished speaking with him on Mount Sinai, he gave Moses the two tablets of the covenant, stone tablets, written with God’s finger.
units.rightText: And he gave unto Moses, when he had made an end of communing with him upon mount Sinai, the two tables of the testimony, tables of stone, written with the finger of God.

units.leftText: When the people saw that Moses delayed coming down from the mountain, the people gathered themselves together to Aaron, and said to him, “Come, make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this Moses, the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.”
units.rightText: And when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down from the mount, the people gathered themselves together unto Aaron, and said unto him, Up, make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we know not what is become of him.

units.leftText: Aaron said to them, “Take off the golden rings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them to me.”
units.rightText: And Aaron said unto them, Break off the golden rings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them unto me.

units.leftText: All the people took off the golden rings which were in their ears, and brought them to Aaron.
units.rightText: And all the people brake off the golden rings which were in their ears, and brought them unto Aaron.

units.leftText: He received what they handed him, fashioned it with an engraving tool, and made it a molded calf. Then they said, “These are your gods, Israel, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt.”
units.rightText: And he received it at their hand, and fashioned it with a graving tool, and made it a molten calf: and they said, These are thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.

units.leftText: When Aaron saw this, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made a proclamation, and said, “Tomorrow shall be a feast to the LORD.”
units.rightText: And when Aaron saw this, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made proclamation, and said, To-morrow shall be a feast to Jehovah.

units.leftText: They rose up early on the next day, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.
units.rightText: And they rose up early on the morrow, and offered burnt-offerings, and brought peace-offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, “Go, get down; for your people, whom you brought up out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves!
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, Go, get thee down; for thy people, that thou broughtest up out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves:

units.leftText: They have turned away quickly out of the way which I commanded them. They have made themselves a molded calf, and have worshiped it, and have sacrificed to it, and said, ‘These are your gods, Israel, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt.’”
units.rightText: they have turned aside quickly out of the way which I commanded them: they have made them a molten calf, and have worshipped it, and have sacrificed unto it, and said, These are thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.

units.leftText: The LORD said to Moses, “I have seen these people, and behold, they are a stiff-necked people.
units.rightText: And Jehovah said unto Moses, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people:

units.leftText: Now therefore leave me alone, that my wrath may burn hot against them, and that I may consume them; and I will make of you a great nation.”
units.rightText: now therefore let me alone, that my wrath may wax hot against them, and that I may consume them: and I will make of thee a great nation.

units.leftText: Moses begged the LORD his God, and said, “LORD, why does your wrath burn hot against your people, that you have brought out of the land of Egypt with great power and with a mighty hand?
units.rightText: And Moses besought Jehovah his God, and said, Jehovah, why doth thy wrath wax hot against thy people, that thou hast brought forth out of the land of Egypt with great power and with a mighty hand?

units.leftText: Why should the Egyptians talk, saying, ‘He brought them out for evil, to kill them in the mountains, and to consume them from the surface of the earth’? Turn from your fierce wrath, and turn away from this evil against your people.
units.rightText: Wherefore should the Egyptians speak, saying, For evil did he bring them forth, to slay them in the mountains, and to consume them from the face of the earth? Turn from thy fierce wrath, and repent of this evil against thy people.

units.leftText: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, your servants, to whom you swore by your own self, and said to them, ‘I will multiply your offspring as the stars of the sky, and all this land that I have spoken of I will give to your offspring, and they shall inherit it forever.’”
units.rightText: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, thy servants, to whom thou swarest by thine own self, and saidst unto them, I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven, and all this land that I have spoken of will I give unto your seed, and they shall inherit it for ever.

units.leftText: So the LORD turned away from the evil which he said he would do to his people.
units.rightText: And Jehovah repented of the evil which he said he would do unto his people.

units.leftText: Moses turned, and went down from the mountain, with the two tablets of the covenant in his hand; tablets that were written on both their sides. They were written on one side and on the other.
units.rightText: And Moses turned, and went down from the mount, with the two tables of the testimony in his hand; tables that were written on both their sides; on the one side and on the other were they written.

units.leftText: The tablets were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, engraved on the tablets.
units.rightText: And the tables were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, graven upon the tables.

units.leftText: When Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said to Moses, “There is the noise of war in the camp.”
units.rightText: And when Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said unto Moses, There is a noise of war in the camp.

units.leftText: He said, “It isn’t the voice of those who shout for victory. It is not the voice of those who cry for being overcome; but the noise of those who sing that I hear.”
units.rightText: And he said, It is not the voice of them that shout for mastery, neither is it the voice of them that cry for being overcome; but the noise of them that sing do I hear.

units.leftText: As soon as he came near to the camp, he saw the calf and the dancing. Then Moses’ anger grew hot, and he threw the tablets out of his hands, and broke them beneath the mountain.
units.rightText: And it came to pass, as soon as he came nigh unto the camp, that he saw the calf and the dancing: and Moses’ anger waxed hot, and he cast the tables out of his hands, and brake them beneath the mount.

units.leftText: He took the calf which they had made, and burned it with fire, ground it to powder, and scattered it on the water, and made the children of Israel drink it.
units.rightText: And he took the calf which they had made, and burnt it with fire, and ground it to powder, and strewed it upon the water, and made the children of Israel drink of it.

units.leftText: Moses said to Aaron, “What did these people do to you, that you have brought a great sin on them?”
units.rightText: And Moses said unto Aaron, What did this people unto thee, that thou hast brought a great sin upon them?

units.leftText: Aaron said, “Don’t let the anger of my lord grow hot. You know the people, that they are set on evil.
units.rightText: And Aaron said, Let not the anger of my lord wax hot: thou knowest the people, that they are set on evil.

units.leftText: For they said to me, ‘Make us gods, which shall go before us. As for this Moses, the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.’
units.rightText: For they said unto me, Make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we know not what is become of him.

units.leftText: I said to them, ‘Whoever has any gold, let them take it off.’ So they gave it to me; and I threw it into the fire, and out came this calf.”
units.rightText: And I said unto them, Whosoever hath any gold, let them break it off: so they gave it me; and I cast it into the fire, and there came out this calf.

units.leftText: When Moses saw that the people were out of control, (for Aaron had let them lose control, causing derision among their enemies),
units.rightText: And when Moses saw that the people were broken loose, (for Aaron had let them loose for a derision among their enemies,)

units.leftText: then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, “Whoever is on the LORD’s side, come to me!”
units.rightText: then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, Whoso is on Jehovah’s side, let him come unto me. And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him.

units.leftText: He said to them, “The LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘Every man put his sword on his thigh, and go back and forth from gate to gate throughout the camp, and every man kill his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbor.’”
units.rightText: And he said unto them, Thus saith Jehovah, the God of Israel, Put ye every man his sword upon his thigh, and go to and fro from gate to gate throughout the camp, and slay every man his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbor.

units.leftText: The sons of Levi did according to the word of Moses. About three thousand men fell of the people that day.
units.rightText: And the sons of Levi did according to the word of Moses: and there fell of the people that day about three thousand men.

units.leftText: Moses said, “Consecrate yourselves today to the LORD, for every man was against his son and against his brother, that he may give you a blessing today.”
units.rightText: And Moses said, Consecrate yourselves to-day to Jehovah, yea, every man against his son, and against his brother; that he may bestow upon you a blessing this day.

units.leftText: On the next day, Moses said to the people, “You have sinned a great sin. Now I will go up to the LORD. Perhaps I shall make atonement for your sin.”
units.rightText: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses said unto the people, Ye have sinned a great sin: and now I will go up unto Jehovah; peradventure I shall make atonement for your sin.

units.leftText: Moses returned to the LORD, and said, “Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made themselves gods of gold.
units.rightText: And Moses returned unto Jehovah, and said, Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made them gods of gold.

units.leftText: Yet now, if you will, forgive their sin—and if not, please blot me out of your book which you have written.”
units.rightText: Yet now, if thou wilt forgive their sin—; and if not, blot me, I pray thee, out of thy book which thou hast written.

units.leftText: The LORD said to Moses, “Whoever has sinned against me, I will blot him out of my book.
units.rightText: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Whosoever hath sinned against me, him will I blot out of my book.

units.leftText: Now go, lead the people to the place of which I have spoken to you. Behold, my angel shall go before you. Nevertheless, in the day when I punish, I will punish them for their sin.”
units.rightText: And now go, lead the people unto the place of which I have spoken unto thee: behold, mine angel shall go before thee; nevertheless in the day when I visit, I will visit their sin upon them.

units.leftText: The LORD struck the people, because of what they did with the calf, which Aaron made.
units.rightText: And Jehovah smote the people, because they made the calf, which Aaron made.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, “Depart, go up from here, you and the people that you have brought up out of the land of Egypt, to the land of which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, ‘I will give it to your offspring.’
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, Depart, go up hence, thou and the people that thou hast brought up out of the land of Egypt, unto the land of which I sware unto Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, Unto thy seed will I give it:

units.leftText: I will send an angel before you; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
units.rightText: and I will send an angel before thee; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:

units.leftText: Go to a land flowing with milk and honey; but I will not go up among you, for you are a stiff-necked people, lest I consume you on the way.”
units.rightText: unto a land flowing with milk and honey: for I will not go up in the midst of thee, for thou art a stiffnecked people, lest I consume thee in the way.

units.leftText: When the people heard this evil news, they mourned; and no one put on his jewelry.
units.rightText: And when the people heard these evil tidings, they mourned: and no man did put on him his ornaments.

units.leftText: The LORD had said to Moses, “Tell the children of Israel, ‘You are a stiff-necked people. If I were to go up among you for one moment, I would consume you. Therefore now take off your jewelry from you, that I may know what to do to you.’”
units.rightText: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Say unto the children of Israel, Ye are a stiffnecked people; if I go up into the midst of thee for one moment, I shall consume thee: therefore now put off thy ornaments from thee, that I may know what to do unto thee.

units.leftText: The children of Israel stripped themselves of their jewelry from Mount Horeb onward.
units.rightText: And the children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments from mount Horeb onward.

units.leftText: Now Moses used to take the tent and pitch it outside the camp, far away from the camp, and he called it “The Tent of Meeting.” Everyone who sought the LORD went out to the Tent of Meeting, which was outside the camp.
units.rightText: Now Moses used to take the tent and to pitch it without the camp, afar off from the camp; and he called it, The tent of meeting. And it came to pass, that every one that sought Jehovah went out unto the tent of meeting, which was without the camp.

units.leftText: When Moses went out to the Tent, all the people rose up, and stood, everyone at their tent door, and watched Moses, until he had gone into the Tent.
units.rightText: And it came to pass, when Moses went out unto the Tent, that all the people rose up, and stood, every man at his tent door, and looked after Moses, until he was gone into the Tent.

units.leftText: When Moses entered into the Tent, the pillar of cloud descended, stood at the door of the Tent, and the LORD spoke with Moses.
units.rightText: And it came to pass, when Moses entered into the Tent, the pillar of cloud descended, and stood at the door of the Tent: and Jehovah spake with Moses.

units.leftText: All the people saw the pillar of cloud stand at the door of the Tent, and all the people rose up and worshiped, everyone at their tent door.
units.rightText: And all the people saw the pillar of cloud stand at the door of the Tent: and all the people rose up and worshipped, every man at his tent door.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses face to face, as a man speaks to his friend. He turned again into the camp, but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, didn’t depart from the Tent.
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses face to face, as a man speaketh unto his friend. And he turned again into the camp: but his minister Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, departed not out of the Tent.

units.leftText: Moses said to the LORD, “Behold, you tell me, ‘Bring up this people;’ and you haven’t let me know whom you will send with me. Yet you have said, ‘I know you by name, and you have also found favor in my sight.’
units.rightText: And Moses said unto Jehovah, See, thou sayest unto me, Bring up this people: and thou hast not let me know whom thou wilt send with me. Yet thou hast said, I know thee by name, and thou hast also found favor in my sight.

units.leftText: Now therefore, if I have found favor in your sight, please show me your way, now, that I may know you, so that I may find favor in your sight; and consider that this nation is your people.”
units.rightText: Now therefore, I pray thee, if I have found favor in thy sight, show me now thy ways, that I may know thee, to the end that I may find favor in thy sight: and consider that this nation is thy people.

units.leftText: He said, “My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”
units.rightText: And he said, My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest.

units.leftText: Moses said to him, “If your presence doesn’t go with me, don’t carry us up from here.
units.rightText: And he said unto him, If thy presence go not with me, carry us not up hence.

units.leftText: For how would people know that I have found favor in your sight, I and your people? Isn’t it that you go with us, so that we are separated, I and your people, from all the people who are on the surface of the earth?”
units.rightText: For wherein now shall it be known that I have found favor in thy sight, I and thy people? is it not in that thou goest with us, so that we are separated, I and thy people, from all the people that are upon the face of the earth?

units.leftText: The LORD said to Moses, “I will do this thing also that you have spoken; for you have found favor in my sight, and I know you by name.”
units.rightText: And Jehovah said unto Moses, I will do this thing also that thou hast spoken; for thou hast found favor in my sight, and I know thee by name.

units.leftText: Moses said, “Please show me your glory.”
units.rightText: And he said, Show me, I pray thee, thy glory.

units.leftText: He said, “I will make all my goodness pass before you, and will proclaim the LORD’s name before you. I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will show mercy on whom I will show mercy.”
units.rightText: And he said, I will make all my goodness pass before thee, and will proclaim the name of Jehovah before thee; and I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will show mercy on whom I will show mercy.

units.leftText: He said, “You cannot see my face, for man may not see me and live.”
units.rightText: And he said, Thou canst not see my face; for man shall not see me and live.

units.leftText: The LORD also said, “Behold, there is a place by me, and you shall stand on the rock.
units.rightText: And Jehovah said, Behold, there is a place by me, and thou shalt stand upon the rock:

units.leftText: It will happen, while my glory passes by, that I will put you in a cleft of the rock, and will cover you with my hand until I have passed by;
units.rightText: and it shall come to pass, while my glory passeth by, that I will put thee in a cleft of the rock, and will cover thee with my hand until I have passed by:

units.leftText: then I will take away my hand, and you will see my back; but my face shall not be seen.”
units.rightText: and I will take away my hand, and thou shalt see my back; but my face shall not be seen.

units.leftText: The LORD said to Moses, “Chisel two stone tablets like the first. I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke.
units.rightText: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first: and I will write upon the tables the words that were on the first tables, which thou brakest.

units.leftText: Be ready by the morning, and come up in the morning to Mount Sinai, and present yourself there to me on the top of the mountain.
units.rightText: And be ready by the morning, and come up in the morning unto mount Sinai, and present thyself there to me on the top of the mount.

units.leftText: No one shall come up with you or be seen anywhere on the mountain. Do not let the flocks or herds graze in front of that mountain.”
units.rightText: And no man shall come up with thee; neither let any man be seen throughout all the mount; neither let the flocks nor herds feed before that mount.

units.leftText: He chiseled two tablets of stone like the first; then Moses rose up early in the morning, and went up to Mount Sinai, as the LORD had commanded him, and took in his hand two stone tablets.
units.rightText: And he hewed two tables of stone like unto the first; and Moses rose up early in the morning, and went up unto mount Sinai, as Jehovah had commanded him, and took in his hand two tables of stone.

units.leftText: The LORD descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed the LORD’s name.
units.rightText: And Jehovah descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed the name of Jehovah.
