units.leftText: The LORD passed by before him, and proclaimed, “The LORD! The LORD, a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth,
units.rightText: And Jehovah passed by before him, and proclaimed, Jehovah, Jehovah, a God merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in lovingkindness and truth;

units.leftText: keeping loving kindness for thousands, forgiving iniquity and disobedience and sin; and who will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, and on the children’s children, on the third and on the fourth generation.”
units.rightText: keeping lovingkindness for thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin; and that will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and upon the children’s children, upon the third and upon the fourth generation.

units.leftText: Moses hurried and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshiped.
units.rightText: And Moses made haste, and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshipped.

units.leftText: He said, “If now I have found favor in your sight, Lord, please let the Lord go among us, even though this is a stiff-necked people; pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for your inheritance.”
units.rightText: And he said, If now I have found favor in thy sight, O Lord, let the Lord, I pray thee, go in the midst of us; for it is a stiffnecked people; and pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for thine inheritance.

units.leftText: He said, “Behold, I make a covenant: before all your people I will do marvels, such as have not been worked in all the earth, nor in any nation; and all the people among whom you are shall see the work of the LORD; for it is an awesome thing that I do with you.
units.rightText: And he said, Behold, I make a covenant: before all thy people I will do marvels, such as have not been wrought in all the earth, nor in any nation; and all the people among which thou art shall see the work of Jehovah; for it is a terrible thing that I do with thee.

units.leftText: Observe that which I command you today. Behold, I will drive out before you the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
units.rightText: Observe thou that which I command thee this day: behold, I drive out before thee the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite.

units.leftText: Be careful, lest you make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land where you are going, lest it be for a snare among you;

units.leftText: but you shall break down their altars, and dash in pieces their pillars, and you shall cut down their Asherah poles;
units.rightText: but ye shall break down their altars, and dash in pieces their pillars, and ye shall cut down their Asherim;

units.rightText: (for thou shalt worship no other god: for Jehovah, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God);

units.rightText: lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, and they play the harlot after their gods, and sacrifice unto their gods, and one call thee and thou eat of his sacrifice;

units.leftText: and you take of their daughters to your sons, and their daughters play the prostitute after their gods, and make your sons play the prostitute after their gods.
units.rightText: and thou take of their daughters unto thy sons, and their daughters play the harlot after their gods, and make thy sons play the harlot after their gods.

units.leftText: “You shall make no cast idols for yourselves.
units.rightText: Thou shalt make thee no molten gods.

units.leftText: “You shall keep the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month Abib; for in the month Abib you came out of Egypt.
units.rightText: The feast of unleavened bread shalt thou keep. Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, as I commanded thee, at the time appointed in the month Abib; for in the month Abib thou camest out from Egypt.

units.leftText: “All that opens the womb is mine; and all your livestock that is male, the firstborn of cow and sheep.
units.rightText: All that openeth the womb is mine; and all thy cattle that is male, the firstlings of cow and sheep.

units.leftText: You shall redeem the firstborn of a donkey with a lamb. If you will not redeem it, then you shall break its neck. You shall redeem all the firstborn of your sons. No one shall appear before me empty.
units.rightText: And the firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb: and if thou wilt not redeem it, then thou shalt break its neck. All the first-born of thy sons thou shalt redeem. And none shall appear before me empty.

units.leftText: “Six days you shall work, but on the seventh day you shall rest: in plowing time and in harvest you shall rest.
units.rightText: Six days thou shalt work, but on the seventh day thou shalt rest: in plowing time and in harvest thou shalt rest.

units.leftText: “You shall observe the feast of weeks with the first fruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of harvest at the year’s end.
units.rightText: And thou shalt observe the feast of weeks, even of the first-fruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of ingathering at the year’s end.

units.leftText: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord GOD, the God of Israel.
units.rightText: Three times in the year shall all thy males appear before the Lord Jehovah, the God of Israel.

units.leftText: For I will drive out nations before you and enlarge your borders; neither shall any man desire your land when you go up to appear before the LORD, your God, three times in the year.
units.rightText: For I will cast out nations before thee, and enlarge thy borders: neither shall any man desire thy land, when thou goest up to appear before Jehovah thy God three times in the year.

units.leftText: “You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread. The sacrifice of the feast of the Passover shall not be left to the morning.
units.rightText: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread; neither shall the sacrifice of the feast of the passover be left unto the morning.

units.leftText: “You shall bring the first of the first fruits of your ground to the house of the LORD your God.
units.rightText: The first of the first-fruits of thy ground thou shalt bring unto the house of Jehovah thy God. Thou shalt not boil a kid in its mother’s milk.

units.leftText: The LORD said to Moses, “Write these words; for in accordance with these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel.”
units.rightText: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Write thou these words: for after the tenor of these words I have made a covenant with thee and with Israel.

units.leftText: He was there with the LORD forty days and forty nights; he neither ate bread, nor drank water. He wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.
units.rightText: And he was there with Jehovah forty days and forty nights; he did neither eat bread, nor drink water. And he wrote upon the tables the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.

units.leftText: When Moses came down from Mount Sinai with the two tablets of the covenant in Moses’ hand, when he came down from the mountain, Moses didn’t know that the skin of his face shone by reason of his speaking with him.
units.rightText: And it came to pass, when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tables of the testimony in Moses’ hand, when he came down from the mount, that Moses knew not that the skin of his face shone by reason of his speaking with him.

units.leftText: When Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come near him.
units.rightText: And when Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come nigh him.

units.leftText: Moses called to them, and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned to him; and Moses spoke to them.
units.rightText: And Moses called unto them; and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned unto him: and Moses spake to them.

units.leftText: Afterward all the children of Israel came near, and he gave them all the commandments that the LORD had spoken with him on Mount Sinai.
units.rightText: And afterward all the children of Israel came nigh: and he gave them in commandment all that Jehovah had spoken with him in mount Sinai.

units.leftText: When Moses was done speaking with them, he put a veil on his face.
units.rightText: And when Moses had done speaking with them, he put a veil on his face.

units.leftText: But when Moses went in before the LORD to speak with him, he took the veil off, until he came out; and he came out, and spoke to the children of Israel that which he was commanded.
units.rightText: But when Moses went in before Jehovah to speak with him, he took the veil off, until he came out; and he came out, and spake unto the children of Israel that which he was commanded.

units.leftText: The children of Israel saw Moses’ face, that the skin of Moses’ face shone; so Moses put the veil on his face again, until he went in to speak with him.
units.rightText: And the children of Israel saw the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses’ face shone: and Moses put the veil upon his face again, until he went in to speak with him.

units.leftText: Moses assembled all the congregation of the children of Israel, and said to them, “These are the words which the LORD has commanded, that you should do them.
units.rightText: And Moses assembled all the congregation of the children of Israel, and said unto them, These are the words which Jehovah hath commanded, that ye should do them.

units.leftText: ‘Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be a holy day for you, a Sabbath of solemn rest to the LORD: whoever does any work in it shall be put to death.
units.rightText: Six days shall work be done; but on the seventh day there shall be to you a holy day, a sabbath of solemn rest to Jehovah: whosoever doeth any work therein shall be put to death.

units.leftText: You shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations on the Sabbath day.’”
units.rightText: Ye shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations upon the sabbath day.

units.leftText: Moses spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, “This is the thing which the LORD commanded, saying,
units.rightText: And Moses spake unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which Jehovah commanded, saying,

units.leftText: ‘Take from among you an offering to the LORD. Whoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it as the LORD’s offering: gold, silver, bronze,
units.rightText: Take ye from among you an offering unto Jehovah; whosoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it, Jehovah’s offering: gold, and silver, and brass,

units.leftText: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair,
units.rightText: and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats’ hair,

units.leftText: rams’ skins dyed red, sea cow hides, acacia wood,
units.rightText: and rams’ skins dyed red, and sealskins, and acacia wood,

units.leftText: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense,
units.rightText: and oil for the light, and spices for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense,

units.leftText: onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate.
units.rightText: and onyx stones, and stones to be set, for the ephod, and for the breastplate.

units.leftText: “‘Let every wise-hearted man among you come, and make all that the LORD has commanded:
units.rightText: And let every wise-hearted man among you come, and make all that Jehovah hath commanded:

units.leftText: the tabernacle, its outer covering, its roof, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its sockets;
units.rightText: the tabernacle, its tent, and its covering, its clasps, and its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its sockets;

units.leftText: the ark, and its poles, the mercy seat, the veil of the screen;
units.rightText: the ark, and the staves thereof, the mercy-seat, and the veil of the screen;

units.rightText: the table, and its staves, and all its vessels, and the showbread;

units.rightText: the candlestick also for the light, and its vessels, and its lamps, and the oil for the light;

units.leftText: and the altar of incense with its poles, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, the screen for the door, at the door of the tabernacle;
units.rightText: and the altar of incense, and its staves, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the screen for the door, at the door of the tabernacle;

units.leftText: the altar of burnt offering, with its grating of bronze, its poles, and all its vessels, the basin and its base;
units.rightText: the altar of burnt-offering, with its grating of brass, its staves, and all its vessels, the laver and its base;

units.leftText: the hangings of the court, its pillars, their sockets, and the screen for the gate of the court;
units.rightText: the hangings of the court, the pillars thereof, and their sockets, and the screen for the gate of the court;

units.leftText: the pins of the tabernacle, the pins of the court, and their cords;
units.rightText: the pins of the tabernacle, and the pins of the court, and their cords;

units.leftText: the finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place—the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons—to minister in the priest’s office.’”
units.rightText: the finely wrought garments, for ministering in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office.

units.leftText: All the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.
units.rightText: And all the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.

units.leftText: They came, everyone whose heart stirred him up, and everyone whom his spirit made willing, and brought the LORD’s offering for the work of the Tent of Meeting, and for all of its service, and for the holy garments.
units.rightText: And they came, every one whose heart stirred him up, and every one whom his spirit made willing, and brought Jehovah’s offering, for the work of the tent of meeting, and for all the service thereof, and for the holy garments.

units.leftText: They came, both men and women, as many as were willing-hearted, and brought brooches, earrings, signet rings, and armlets, all jewels of gold; even every man who offered an offering of gold to the LORD.
units.rightText: And they came, both men and women, as many as were willing-hearted, and brought brooches, and ear-rings, and signet-rings, and armlets, all jewels of gold; even every man that offered an offering of gold unto Jehovah.

units.leftText: Everyone with whom was found blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair, rams’ skins dyed red, and sea cow hides, brought them.
units.rightText: And every man, with whom was found blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats’ hair, and rams’ skins dyed red, and sealskins, brought them.

units.leftText: Everyone who offered an offering of silver and bronze brought the LORD’s offering; and everyone with whom was found acacia wood for any work of the service, brought it.
units.rightText: Every one that did offer an offering of silver and brass brought Jehovah’s offering; and every man, with whom was found acacia wood for any work of the service, brought it.

units.leftText: All the women who were wise-hearted spun with their hands, and brought that which they had spun: the blue, the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen.
units.rightText: And all the women that were wise-hearted did spin with their hands, and brought that which they had spun, the blue, and the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen.

units.leftText: All the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun the goats’ hair.
units.rightText: And all the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun the goats’ hair.

units.leftText: The rulers brought the onyx stones and the stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate;
units.rightText: And the rulers brought the onyx stones, and the stones to be set, for the ephod, and for the breastplate;

units.leftText: with the spice and the oil for the light, for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.
units.rightText: and the spice, and the oil; for the light, and for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.

units.leftText: The children of Israel brought a free will offering to the LORD; every man and woman whose heart made them willing to bring for all the work, which the LORD had commanded to be made by Moses.
units.rightText: The children of Israel brought a freewill-offering unto Jehovah; every man and woman, whose heart made them willing to bring for all the work, which Jehovah had commanded to be made by Moses.

units.leftText: Moses said to the children of Israel, “Behold, the LORD has called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
units.rightText: And Moses said unto the children of Israel, See, Jehovah hath called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah;

units.leftText: He has filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, in knowledge, and in all kinds of workmanship;
units.rightText: and he hath filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship;

units.leftText: and to make skillful works, to work in gold, in silver, in bronze,
units.rightText: and to devise skilful works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,

units.leftText: in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all kinds of skillful workmanship.
units.rightText: and in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all manner of skilful workmanship.

units.leftText: He has put in his heart that he may teach, both he and Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.
units.rightText: And he hath put in his heart that he may teach, both he, and Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.

units.leftText: He has filled them with wisdom of heart to work all kinds of workmanship, of the engraver, of the skillful workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of those who do any workmanship, and of those who make skillful works.
units.rightText: Them hath he filled with wisdom of heart, to work all manner of workmanship, of the engraver, and of the skilful workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, and in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of them that do any workmanship, and of those that devise skilful works.

units.leftText: “Bezalel and Oholiab shall work with every wise-hearted man, in whom the LORD has put wisdom and understanding to know how to do all the work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that the LORD has commanded.”
units.rightText: And Bezalel and Oholiab shall work, and every wise-hearted man, in whom Jehovah hath put wisdom and understanding to know how to work all the work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that Jehovah hath commanded.

units.leftText: Moses called Bezalel and Oholiab, and every wise-hearted man, in whose heart the LORD had put wisdom, even everyone whose heart stirred him up to come to the work to do it.
units.rightText: And Moses called Bezalel and Oholiab, and every wise-hearted man, in whose heart Jehovah had put wisdom, even every one whose heart stirred him up to come unto the work to do it:

units.leftText: They received from Moses all the offering which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, with which to make it. They kept bringing free will offerings to him every morning.
units.rightText: and they received of Moses all the offering which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, wherewith to make it. And they brought yet unto him freewill-offerings every morning.

units.leftText: All the wise men, who performed all the work of the sanctuary, each came from his work which he did.
units.rightText: And all the wise men, that wrought all the work of the sanctuary, came every man from his work which they wrought;

units.leftText: They spoke to Moses, saying, “The people have brought much more than enough for the service of the work which the LORD commanded to make.”
units.rightText: and they spake unto Moses, saying, The people bring much more than enough for the service of the work which Jehovah commanded to make.

units.leftText: Moses gave a commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, “Let neither man nor woman make anything else for the offering for the sanctuary.” So the people were restrained from bringing.
units.rightText: And Moses gave commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, Let neither man nor woman make any more work for the offering of the sanctuary. So the people were restrained from bringing.

units.leftText: For the stuff they had was sufficient to do all the work, and too much.
units.rightText: For the stuff they had was sufficient for all the work to make it, and too much.

units.leftText: All the wise-hearted men among those who did the work made the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet. They made them with cherubim, the work of a skillful workman.
units.rightText: And all the wise-hearted men among them that wrought the work made the tabernacle with ten curtains; of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, with cherubim, the work of the skilful workman, Bezalel made them.

units.leftText: The length of each curtain was twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits. All the curtains had one measure.
units.rightText: The length of each curtain was eight and twenty cubits, and the breadth of each curtain four cubits: all the curtains had one measure.
leftNotes: 36:9 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters.

units.leftText: He coupled five curtains to one another, and the other five curtains he coupled to one another.
units.rightText: And he coupled five curtains one to another: and the other five curtains he coupled one to another.

units.leftText: He made loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling. Likewise he made in the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the second coupling.
units.rightText: And he made loops of blue upon the edge of the one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling: likewise he made in the edge of the curtain that was outmost in the second coupling.

units.leftText: He made fifty loops in the one curtain, and he made fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that was in the second coupling. The loops were opposite to one another.
units.rightText: Fifty loops made he in the one curtain, and fifty loops made he in the edge of the curtain that was in the second coupling: the loops were opposite one to another.

units.leftText: He made fifty clasps of gold, and coupled the curtains to one another with the clasps: so the tabernacle was a unit.
units.rightText: And he made fifty clasps of gold, and coupled the curtains one to another with the clasps: so the tabernacle was one.

units.leftText: He made curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. He made them eleven curtains.
units.rightText: And he made curtains of goats’ hair for a tent over the tabernacle: eleven curtains he made them.

units.leftText: The length of each curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits the width of each curtain. The eleven curtains had one measure.
units.rightText: The length of each curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits the breadth of each curtain: the eleven curtains had one measure.

units.leftText: He coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.
units.rightText: And he coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.

units.leftText: He made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the coupling, and he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which was outermost in the second coupling.
units.rightText: And he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that was outmost in the coupling, and fifty loops made he upon the edge of the curtain which was outmost in the second coupling.

units.leftText: He made fifty clasps of bronze to couple the tent together, that it might be a unit.
units.rightText: And he made fifty clasps of brass to couple the tent together, that it might be one.

units.leftText: He made a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.
units.rightText: And he made a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sealskins above.

units.leftText: He made the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing up.
units.rightText: And he made the boards for the tabernacle, of acacia wood, standing up.

units.leftText: Ten cubits was the length of a board, and a cubit and a half the width of each board.
units.rightText: Ten cubits was the length of a board, and a cubit and a half the breadth of each board.

units.leftText: Each board had two tenons, joined to one another. He made all the boards of the tabernacle this way.
units.rightText: Each board had two tenons, joined one to another: thus did he make for all the boards of the tabernacle.

units.leftText: He made the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards for the south side southward.
units.rightText: And he made the boards for the tabernacle: twenty boards for the south side southward;

units.leftText: He made forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards: two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.
units.rightText: and he made forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.

units.leftText: For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, he made twenty boards
units.rightText: And for the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, he made twenty boards,

units.leftText: and their forty sockets of silver: two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
units.rightText: and their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

units.leftText: For the far part of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.
units.rightText: And for the hinder part of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.

units.leftText: He made two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far part.
units.rightText: And two boards made he for the corners of the tabernacle in the hinder part.

units.leftText: They were double beneath, and in the same way they were all the way to its top to one ring. He did this to both of them in the two corners.
units.rightText: And they were double beneath; and in like manner they were entire unto the top thereof unto one ring: thus he did to both of them in the two corners.

units.leftText: There were eight boards and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets—under every board two sockets.
units.rightText: And there were eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; under every board two sockets.

units.leftText: He made bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
units.rightText: And he made bars of acacia wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

units.leftText: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the hinder part westward.
units.rightText: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the hinder part westward.

units.leftText: He made the middle bar to pass through in the middle of the boards from the one end to the other.
units.rightText: And he made the middle bar to pass through in the midst of the boards from the one end to the other.

units.leftText: He overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold as places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.
units.rightText: And he overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold for places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.

units.leftText: He made the veil of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. He made it the work of a skillful workman.
units.rightText: And he made the veil of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: with cherubim, the work of the skilful workman, made he it.

units.leftText: He made four pillars of acacia for it, and overlaid them with gold. Their hooks were of gold. He cast four sockets of silver for them.
units.rightText: And he made thereunto four pillars of acacia, and overlaid them with gold: their hooks were of gold; and he cast for them four sockets of silver.

units.leftText: He made a screen for the door of the tent, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of an embroiderer;
units.rightText: And he made a screen for the door of the Tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer;

units.leftText: and the five pillars of it with their hooks. He overlaid their capitals and their fillets with gold, and their five sockets were of bronze.
units.rightText: and the five pillars of it with their hooks: and he overlaid their capitals and their fillets with gold; and their five sockets were of brass.

units.leftText: Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood. Its length was two and a half cubits, and its width a cubit and a half, and a cubit and a half its height.
units.rightText: And Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood: two cubits and a half was the length of it, and a cubit and a half the breadth of it, and a cubit and a half the height of it.
leftNotes: 37:1 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters.

units.leftText: He overlaid it with pure gold inside and outside, and made a molding of gold for it around it.
units.rightText: And he overlaid it with pure gold within and without, and made a crown of gold to it round about.

units.leftText: He cast four rings of gold for it in its four feet—two rings on its one side, and two rings on its other side.
units.rightText: And he cast for it four rings of gold, in the four feet thereof; even two rings on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.

units.leftText: He made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.
units.rightText: And he made staves of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold.

units.leftText: He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.
units.rightText: And he put the staves into the rings on the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.

units.leftText: He made a mercy seat of pure gold. Its length was two and a half cubits, and a cubit and a half its width.
units.rightText: And he made a mercy-seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half was the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof.

units.leftText: He made two cherubim of gold. He made them of beaten work, at the two ends of the mercy seat:
units.rightText: And he made two cherubim of gold; of beaten work made he them, at the two ends of the mercy-seat;

units.leftText: one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. He made the cherubim of one piece with the mercy seat at its two ends.
units.rightText: one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end: of one piece with the mercy-seat made he the cherubim at the two ends thereof.

units.rightText: And the cherubim spread out their wings on high, covering the mercy-seat with their wings, with their faces one to another; toward the mercy-seat were the faces of the cherubim.

units.leftText: He made the table of acacia wood. Its length was two cubits, and its width was a cubit, and its height was a cubit and a half.
units.rightText: And he made the table of acacia wood: two cubits was the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.

units.leftText: He overlaid it with pure gold, and made a gold molding around it.
units.rightText: And he overlaid it with pure gold, and made thereto a crown of gold round about.

units.leftText: He made a border of a hand’s width around it, and made a golden molding on its border around it.

units.leftText: He cast four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that were on its four feet.

units.leftText: The rings were close by the border, the places for the poles to carry the table.

units.leftText: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold, to carry the table.
units.rightText: And he made the staves of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold, to bear the table.

units.leftText: He made the vessels which were on the table, its dishes, its spoons, its bowls, and its pitchers with which to pour out, of pure gold.
units.rightText: And he made the vessels which were upon the table, the dishes thereof, and the spoons thereof, and the bowls thereof, and the flagons thereof, wherewith to pour out, of pure gold.

units.rightText: And he made the candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work made he the candlestick, even its base, and its shaft; its cups, its knops, and its flowers, were of one piece with it.

units.rightText: And there were six branches going out of the sides thereof; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side thereof, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side thereof:

units.leftText: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower, and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower; so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand.
units.rightText: three cups made like almond-blossoms in one branch, a knop and a flower, and three cups made like almond-blossoms in the other branch, a knop and a flower: so for the six branches going out of the candlestick.

units.leftText: In the lamp stand were four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers;
units.rightText: And in the candlestick were four cups made like almond-blossoms, the knops thereof, and the flowers thereof;

units.leftText: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of it.
units.rightText: and a knop under two branches of one piece with it, and a knop under two branches of one piece with it, and a knop under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of it.

units.leftText: Their buds and their branches were of one piece with it. The whole thing was one beaten work of pure gold.
units.rightText: Their knops and their branches were of one piece with it: the whole of it was one beaten work of pure gold.

units.leftText: He made its seven lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuff dishes, of pure gold.
units.rightText: And he made the lamps thereof, seven, and the snuffers thereof, and the snuffdishes thereof, of pure gold.

units.leftText: He made it of a talent of pure gold, with all its vessels.
units.rightText: Of a talent of pure gold made he it, and all the vessels thereof.
leftNotes: 37:24 A talent is about 30 kilograms or 66 pounds or 965 Troy ounces

units.leftText: He made the altar of incense of acacia wood. It was square: its length was a cubit, and its width a cubit. Its height was two cubits. Its horns were of one piece with it.
units.rightText: And he made the altar of incense of acacia wood: a cubit was the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, foursquare; and two cubits was the height thereof; the horns thereof were of one piece with it.

units.leftText: He overlaid it with pure gold: its top, its sides around it, and its horns. He made a gold molding around it.
units.rightText: And he overlaid it with pure gold, the top thereof, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns of it: and he made unto it a crown of gold round about.

units.leftText: He made two golden rings for it under its molding crown, on its two ribs, on its two sides, for places for poles with which to carry it.
units.rightText: And he made for it two golden rings under the crown thereof, upon the two ribs thereof, upon the two sides of it, for places for staves wherewith to bear it.

units.leftText: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold.
units.rightText: And he made the staves of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold.

units.leftText: He made the holy anointing oil and the pure incense of sweet spices, after the art of the perfumer.
units.rightText: And he made the holy anointing oil, and the pure incense of sweet spices, after the art of the perfumer.

units.leftText: He made the altar of burnt offering of acacia wood. It was square. Its length was five cubits, its width was five cubits, and its height was three cubits.
units.rightText: And he made the altar of burnt-offering of acacia wood: five cubits was the length thereof, and five cubits the breadth thereof, foursquare; and three cubits the height thereof.
leftNotes: 38:1 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters.

units.leftText: He made its horns on its four corners. Its horns were of one piece with it, and he overlaid it with bronze.
units.rightText: And he made the horns thereof upon the four corners of it; the horns thereof were of one piece with it: and he overlaid it with brass.

units.leftText: He made all the vessels of the altar: the pots, the shovels, the basins, the forks, and the fire pans. He made all its vessels of bronze.
units.rightText: And he made all the vessels of the altar, the pots, and the shovels, and the basins, the flesh-hooks, and the firepans: all the vessels thereof made he of brass.

units.leftText: He made for the altar a grating of a network of bronze, under the ledge around it beneath, reaching halfway up.
units.rightText: And he made for the altar a grating of network of brass, under the ledge round it beneath, reaching halfway up.

units.leftText: He cast four rings for the four corners of bronze grating, to be places for the poles.
units.rightText: And he cast four rings for the four ends of the grating of brass, to be places for the staves.

units.leftText: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with bronze.
units.rightText: And he made the staves of acacia wood, and overlaid them with brass.

units.leftText: He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the altar, with which to carry it. He made it hollow with planks.
units.rightText: And he put the staves into the rings on the sides of the altar, wherewith to bear it; he made it hollow with planks.

units.leftText: He made the basin of bronze, and its base of bronze, out of the mirrors of the ministering women who ministered at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
units.rightText: And he made the laver of brass, and the base thereof of brass, of the mirrors of the ministering women that ministered at the door of the tent of meeting.

units.leftText: He made the court: for the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, one hundred cubits;
units.rightText: And he made the court: for the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, a hundred cubits;

units.leftText: their pillars were twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.
units.rightText: their pillars were twenty, and their sockets twenty, of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.

units.leftText: For the north side one hundred cubits, their pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.
units.rightText: And for the north side a hundred cubits, their pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of brass; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.

units.leftText: For the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.
units.rightText: And for the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.

units.leftText: For the east side eastward fifty cubits,
units.rightText: And for the east side eastward fifty cubits.

units.leftText: the hangings for the one side were fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three;
units.rightText: The hangings for the one side of the gate were fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three;

units.leftText: and so for the other side: on this hand and that hand by the gate of the court were hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
units.rightText: and so for the other side: on this hand and that hand by the gate of the court were hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

units.leftText: All the hangings around the court were of fine twined linen.
units.rightText: All the hangings of the court round about were of fine twined linen.

units.leftText: The sockets for the pillars were of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver. Their capitals were overlaid with silver. All the pillars of the court had silver bands.
units.rightText: And the sockets for the pillars were of brass; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver; and the overlaying of their capitals, of silver; and all the pillars of the court were filleted with silver.

units.leftText: The screen for the gate of the court was the work of the embroiderer, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen. Twenty cubits was the length, and the height along the width was five cubits, like the hangings of the court.
units.rightText: And the screen for the gate of the court was the work of the embroiderer, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: and twenty cubits was the length, and the height in the breadth was five cubits, answerable to the hangings of the court.

units.leftText: Their pillars were four, and their sockets four, of bronze; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their capitals, and their fillets, of silver.
units.rightText: And their pillars were four, and their sockets four, of brass; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their capitals, and their fillets, of silver.

units.leftText: All the pins of the tabernacle, and around the court, were of bronze.
units.rightText: And all the pins of the tabernacle, and of the court round about, were of brass.

units.leftText: These are the amounts of materials used for the tabernacle, even the Tabernacle of the Testimony, as they were counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest.
units.rightText: This is the sum of the things for the tabernacle, even the tabernacle of the testimony, as they were counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest.

units.leftText: Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that the LORD commanded Moses.
units.rightText: And Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that Jehovah commanded Moses.

units.leftText: With him was Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a skillful workman, and an embroiderer in blue, in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen.
units.rightText: And with him was Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a skilful workman, and an embroiderer in blue, and in purple, and in scarlet, and in fine linen.

units.leftText: All the gold that was used for the work in all the work of the sanctuary, even the gold of the offering, was twenty-nine talents and seven hundred thirty shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.
units.rightText: All the gold that was used for the work in all the work of the sanctuary, even the gold of the offering, was twenty and nine talents, and seven hundred and thirty shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
leftNotes: 38:24 A talent is about 30 kilograms or 66 pounds or 965 Troy ounces.
38:24 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.32 Troy ounces.

units.leftText: The silver of those who were counted of the congregation was one hundred talents and one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary:
units.rightText: And the silver of them that were numbered of the congregation was a hundred talents, and a thousand seven hundred and threescore and fifteen shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
leftNotes: 38:25 A talent is about 30 kilograms or 66 pounds
38:25 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces.

units.leftText: a beka a head, that is, half a shekel, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, for everyone who passed over to those who were counted, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty men.
units.rightText: a beka a head, that is, half a shekel, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for every one that passed over to them that were numbered, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty men.
leftNotes: 38:26 a beka is about 5 grams or about 0.175 ounces
38:26 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces.

units.leftText: The one hundred talents of silver were for casting the sockets of the sanctuary and the sockets of the veil: one hundred sockets for the one hundred talents, one talent per socket.
units.rightText: And the hundred talents of silver were for casting the sockets of the sanctuary, and the sockets of the veil; a hundred sockets for the hundred talents, a talent for a socket.
leftNotes: 38:27 A talent is about 30 kilograms or 66 pounds.

units.leftText: From the one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, overlaid their capitals, and made fillets for them.
units.rightText: And of the thousand seven hundred seventy and five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, and overlaid their capitals, and made fillets for them.
leftNotes: 38:28 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces, so 1775 shekels is about 17.75 kilograms or about 39 pounds.

units.leftText: The bronze of the offering was seventy talents and two thousand four hundred shekels.
units.rightText: And the brass of the offering was seventy talents, and two thousand and four hundred shekels.
leftNotes: 38:29 A talent is about 30 kilograms or 66 pounds
38:29 70 talents + 2400 shekels is about 2124 kilograms, or 2.124 metric tons.

units.leftText: With this he made the sockets to the door of the Tent of Meeting, the bronze altar, the bronze grating for it, all the vessels of the altar,
units.rightText: And therewith he made the sockets to the door of the tent of meeting, and the brazen altar, and the brazen grating for it, and all the vessels of the altar,

units.leftText: the sockets around the court, the sockets of the gate of the court, all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins around the court.
units.rightText: and the sockets of the court round about, and the sockets of the gate of the court, and all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins of the court round about.

units.leftText: Of the blue, purple, and scarlet, they made finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron, as the LORD commanded Moses.
units.rightText: And of the blue, and purple, and scarlet, they made finely wrought garments, for ministering in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

units.leftText: He made the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.
units.rightText: And he made the ephod of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.

units.leftText: They beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in with the blue, the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen, the work of the skillful workman.
units.rightText: And they did beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in the blue, and in the purple, and in the scarlet, and in the fine linen, the work of the skilful workman.

units.leftText: They made shoulder straps for it, joined together. It was joined together at the two ends.
units.rightText: They made shoulder-pieces for it, joined together; at the two ends was it joined together.

units.leftText: The skillfully woven band that was on it, with which to fasten it on, was of the same piece, like its work: of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, as the LORD commanded Moses.
units.rightText: And the skilfully woven band, that was upon it, wherewith to gird it on, was of the same piece and like the work thereof; of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

units.leftText: They worked the onyx stones, enclosed in settings of gold, engraved with the engravings of a signet, according to the names of the children of Israel.
units.rightText: And they wrought the onyx stones, inclosed in settings of gold, graven with the engravings of a signet, according to the names of the children of Israel.

units.leftText: He put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel, as the LORD commanded Moses.
units.rightText: And he put them on the shoulder-pieces of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

units.leftText: He made the breastplate, the work of a skillful workman, like the work of the ephod: of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.
units.rightText: And he made the breastplate, the work of the skilful workman, like the work of the ephod; of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.

units.leftText: It was square. They made the breastplate double. Its length was a span, and its width a span, being double.
units.rightText: It was foursquare; they made the breastplate double: a span was the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof, being double.
leftNotes: 39:9 A span is the length from the tip of a man’s thumb to the tip of his little finger when his hand is stretched out (about half a cubit, or 9 inches, or 22.8 cm.)

units.leftText: They set in it four rows of stones. A row of ruby, topaz, and beryl was the first row;
units.rightText: And they set in it four rows of stones. A row of sardius, topaz, and carbuncle was the first row;

units.leftText: and the second row, a turquoise, a sapphire, and an emerald;
units.rightText: and the second row, an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond;
leftNotes: 39:11 or, lapis lazuli

units.leftText: and the third row, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
units.rightText: and the third row, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

units.leftText: and the fourth row, a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They were enclosed in gold settings.
units.rightText: and the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper: they were inclosed in inclosings of gold in their settings.

units.leftText: The stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, everyone according to his name, for the twelve tribes.
units.rightText: And the stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, every one according to his name, for the twelve tribes.

units.leftText: They made on the breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold.
units.rightText: And they made upon the breastplate chains like cords, of wreathen work of pure gold.

units.leftText: They made two settings of gold, and two gold rings, and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.
units.rightText: And they made two settings of gold, and two gold rings, and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.

units.leftText: They put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.
units.rightText: And they put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.

units.leftText: The other two ends of the two braided chains they put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, in its front.
units.rightText: And the other two ends of the two wreathen chains they put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder-pieces of the ephod, in the forepart thereof.

units.leftText: They made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its edge, which was toward the side of the ephod inward.
units.rightText: And they made two rings of gold, and put them upon the two ends of the breastplate, upon the edge thereof, which was toward the side of the ephod inward.

units.leftText: They made two more rings of gold, and put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath, in its front, close by its coupling, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.
units.rightText: And they made two rings of gold, and put them on the two shoulder-pieces of the ephod underneath, in the forepart thereof, close by the coupling thereof, above the skilfully woven band of the ephod.

units.leftText: They bound the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not come loose from the ephod, as the LORD commanded Moses.
units.rightText: And they did bind the breastplate by the rings thereof unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be upon the skilfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

units.leftText: He made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.
units.rightText: And he made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue;

units.leftText: The opening of the robe in the middle of it was like the opening of a coat of mail, with a binding around its opening, that it should not be torn.
units.rightText: and the hole of the robe in the midst thereof, as the hole of a coat of mail, with a binding round about the hole of it, that it should not be rent.

units.leftText: They made on the skirts of the robe pomegranates of blue, purple, scarlet, and twined linen.
units.rightText: And they made upon the skirts of the robe pomegranates of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen.

units.leftText: They made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates around the skirts of the robe, between the pomegranates;
units.rightText: And they made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates upon the skirts of the robe round about, between the pomegranates;

units.leftText: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, around the skirts of the robe, to minister in, as the LORD commanded Moses.
units.rightText: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, upon the skirts of the robe round about, to minister in; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

units.leftText: They made the tunics of fine linen of woven work for Aaron and for his sons,
units.rightText: And they made the coats of fine linen of woven work for Aaron, and for his sons,

units.leftText: the turban of fine linen, the linen headbands of fine linen, the linen trousers of fine twined linen,
units.rightText: and the mitre of fine linen, and the goodly head-tires of fine linen, and the linen breeches of fine twined linen,

units.leftText: the sash of fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet, the work of the embroiderer, as the LORD commanded Moses.
units.rightText: and the girdle of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, the work of the embroiderer; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

units.leftText: They made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote on it an inscription, like the engravings of a signet: “HOLY TO THE LORD”.
units.rightText: And they made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote upon it a writing, like the engravings of a signet, HOLY TO JEHOVAH.

units.leftText: They tied to it a lace of blue, to fasten it on the turban above, as the LORD commanded Moses.
units.rightText: And they tied unto it a lace of blue, to fasten it upon the mitre above; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

units.leftText: Thus all the work of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting was finished. The children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses; so they did.
units.rightText: Thus was finished all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting: and the children of Israel did according to all that Jehovah commanded Moses; so did they.

units.leftText: They brought the tabernacle to Moses: the tent, with all its furniture, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets,
units.rightText: And they brought the tabernacle unto Moses, the Tent, and all its furniture, its clasps, its boards, its bars, and its pillars, and its sockets;

units.leftText: the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, the covering of sea cow hides, the veil of the screen,
units.rightText: and the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, and the covering of sealskins, and the veil of the screen;

units.leftText: the ark of the covenant with its poles, the mercy seat,
units.rightText: the ark of the testimony, and the staves thereof, and the mercy-seat;

units.leftText: the table, all its vessels, the show bread,
units.rightText: the table, all the vessels thereof, and the showbread;

units.leftText: the pure lamp stand, its lamps, even the lamps to be set in order, all its vessels, the oil for the light,
units.rightText: the pure candlestick, the lamps thereof, even the lamps to be set in order, and all the vessels thereof, and the oil for the light;

units.leftText: the golden altar, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, the screen for the door of the Tent,
units.rightText: and the golden altar, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the screen for the door of the Tent;

units.leftText: the bronze altar, its grating of bronze, its poles, all of its vessels, the basin and its base,
units.rightText: the brazen altar, and its grating of brass, its staves, and all its vessels, the laver and its base;

units.leftText: the hangings of the court, its pillars, its sockets, the screen for the gate of the court, its cords, its pins, and all the instruments of the service of the tabernacle, for the Tent of Meeting,
units.rightText: the hangings of the court, its pillars, and its sockets, and the screen for the gate of the court, the cords thereof, and the pins thereof, and all the instruments of the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of meeting;

units.leftText: the finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office.
units.rightText: the finely wrought garments for ministering in the holy place, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office.

units.leftText: According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did all the work.
units.rightText: According to all that Jehovah commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did all the work.

units.leftText: Moses saw all the work, and behold, they had done it as the LORD had commanded. They had done so; and Moses blessed them.
units.rightText: And Moses saw all the work, and, behold, they had done it; as Jehovah had commanded, even so had they done it: and Moses blessed them.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “On the first day of the first month you shall raise up the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.
units.rightText: On the first day of the first month shalt thou rear up the tabernacle of the tent of meeting.

units.leftText: You shall put the ark of the covenant in it, and you shall screen the ark with the veil.
units.rightText: And thou shalt put therein the ark of the testimony, and thou shalt screen the ark with the veil.

units.leftText: You shall bring in the table, and set in order the things that are on it. You shall bring in the lamp stand, and light its lamps.
units.rightText: And thou shalt bring in the table, and set in order the things that are upon it; and thou shalt bring in the candlestick, and light the lamps thereof.

units.leftText: You shall set the golden altar for incense before the ark of the covenant, and put the screen of the door to the tabernacle.
units.rightText: And thou shalt set the golden altar for incense before the ark of the testimony, and put the screen of the door to the tabernacle.

units.leftText: “You shall set the altar of burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.
units.rightText: And thou shalt set the altar of burnt-offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting.

units.leftText: You shall set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and shall put water therein.
units.rightText: And thou shalt set the laver between the tent of meeting and the altar, and shalt put water therein.

units.leftText: You shall set up the court around it, and hang up the screen of the gate of the court.
units.rightText: And thou shalt set up the court round about, and hang up the screen of the gate of the court.

units.leftText: “You shall take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle and all that is in it, and shall make it holy, and all its furniture, and it will be holy.
units.rightText: And thou shalt take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle, and all that is therein, and shalt hallow it, and all the furniture thereof: and it shall be holy.

units.leftText: You shall anoint the altar of burnt offering, with all its vessels, and sanctify the altar, and the altar will be most holy.
units.rightText: And thou shalt anoint the altar of burnt-offering, and all its vessels, and sanctify the altar: and the altar shall be most holy.

units.leftText: You shall anoint the basin and its base, and sanctify it.
units.rightText: And thou shalt anoint the laver and its base, and sanctify it.

units.leftText: “You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and shall wash them with water.
units.rightText: And thou shalt bring Aaron and his sons unto the door of the tent of meeting, and shalt wash them with water.

units.leftText: You shall put on Aaron the holy garments; and you shall anoint him, and sanctify him, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.
units.rightText: And thou shalt put upon Aaron the holy garments; and thou shalt anoint him, and sanctify him, that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office.

units.leftText: You shall bring his sons, and put tunics on them.
units.rightText: And thou shalt bring his sons, and put coats upon them;

units.leftText: You shall anoint them, as you anointed their father, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office. Their anointing shall be to them for an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.”
units.rightText: and thou shalt anoint them, as thou didst anoint their father, that they may minister unto me in the priest’s office: and their anointing shall be to them for an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.

units.leftText: Moses did so. According to all that the LORD commanded him, so he did.
units.rightText: Thus did Moses: according to all that Jehovah commanded him, so did he.

units.leftText: In the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, the tabernacle was raised up.
units.rightText: And it came to pass in the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, that the tabernacle was reared up.

units.leftText: Moses raised up the tabernacle, and laid its sockets, and set up its boards, and put in its bars, and raised up its pillars.
units.rightText: And Moses reared up the tabernacle, and laid its sockets, and set up the boards thereof, and put in the bars thereof, and reared up its pillars.

units.leftText: He spread the covering over the tent, and put the roof of the tabernacle above on it, as the LORD commanded Moses.
units.rightText: And he spread the tent over the tabernacle, and put the covering of the tent above upon it; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

units.leftText: He took and put the covenant into the ark, and set the poles on the ark, and put the mercy seat above on the ark.
units.rightText: And he took and put the testimony into the ark, and set the staves on the ark, and put the mercy-seat above upon the ark:

units.leftText: He brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the veil of the screen, and screened the ark of the covenant, as the LORD commanded Moses.
units.rightText: and he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the veil of the screen, and screened the ark of the testimony; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

units.leftText: He put the table in the Tent of Meeting, on the north side of the tabernacle, outside of the veil.
units.rightText: And he put the table in the tent of meeting, upon the side of the tabernacle northward, without the veil.

units.leftText: He set the bread in order on it before the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.
units.rightText: And he set the bread in order upon it before Jehovah; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

units.leftText: He put the lamp stand in the Tent of Meeting, opposite the table, on the south side of the tabernacle.
units.rightText: And he put the candlestick in the tent of meeting, over against the table, on the side of the tabernacle southward.

units.leftText: He lit the lamps before the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.
units.rightText: And he lighted the lamps before Jehovah; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

units.leftText: He put the golden altar in the Tent of Meeting before the veil;
units.rightText: And he put the golden altar in the tent of meeting before the veil:

units.leftText: and he burned incense of sweet spices on it, as the LORD commanded Moses.
units.rightText: and he burnt thereon incense of sweet spices; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

units.leftText: He put up the screen of the door to the tabernacle.
units.rightText: And he put the screen of the door to the tabernacle.

units.leftText: He set the altar of burnt offering at the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting, and offered on it the burnt offering and the meal offering, as the LORD commanded Moses.
units.rightText: And he set the altar of burnt-offering at the door of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting, and offered upon it the burnt-offering and the meal-offering; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

units.leftText: He set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water therein, with which to wash.
units.rightText: And he set the laver between the tent of meeting and the altar, and put water therein, wherewith to wash.

units.leftText: Moses, Aaron, and his sons washed their hands and their feet there.
units.rightText: And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet thereat;

units.leftText: When they went into the Tent of Meeting, and when they came near to the altar, they washed, as the LORD commanded Moses.
units.rightText: when they went into the tent of meeting, and when they came near unto the altar, they washed; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

units.leftText: He raised up the court around the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the screen of the gate of the court. So Moses finished the work.
units.rightText: And he reared up the court round about the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the screen of the gate of the court. So Moses finished the work.

units.leftText: Then the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and the LORD’s glory filled the tabernacle.
units.rightText: Then the cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the glory of Jehovah filled the tabernacle.

units.leftText: Moses wasn’t able to enter into the Tent of Meeting, because the cloud stayed on it, and the LORD’s glory filled the tabernacle.
units.rightText: And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of meeting, because the cloud abode thereon, and the glory of Jehovah filled the tabernacle.

units.leftText: When the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward, throughout all their journeys;
units.rightText: And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward, throughout all their journeys:

units.leftText: but if the cloud wasn’t taken up, then they didn’t travel until the day that it was taken up.
units.rightText: but if the cloud was not taken up, then they journeyed not till the day that it was taken up.

units.leftText: For the cloud of the LORD was on the tabernacle by day, and there was fire in the cloud by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.
units.rightText: For the cloud of Jehovah was upon the tabernacle by day, and there was fire therein by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.
